title: Allahabad High Court quashes UP civil services preliminary result, orders a fresh one
dek: The ruling on the UPPSC PCS-2025 exam, for 814 posts, is expected to help reserved-category candidates. The commission must redo the result before later stages.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
The Allahabad High Court on Friday set aside the result of the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission's PCS-2025 preliminary examination and directed the commission to prepare and declare a fresh result, according to reports.

Justice Manish Kumar Nigam, sitting alone, ruled on petitions filed by four candidates who had challenged certain provisions of the recruitment advertisement. The court had reserved its judgment on 28 September. The recruitment is for 814 posts in the state's provincial civil services and allied services.

The ruling is expected to benefit candidates from reserved categories, according to reports, but the court's detailed reasoning and the exact provisions it found fault with had not been published by Saturday morning. Once a fresh preliminary result is declared, the commission will go ahead with the remaining stages of selection, the main written examination and the interview.

The commission has not said whether it will appeal to a division bench. The PCS exam is one of the most competitive in the country, and any delay to the schedule affects lakhs of aspirants who prepare for it each year.
